newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Electric wins Changi airport system order.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Electric wins Changi airport system order.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp said on Thursday it had won a S$7 million order for a meteorological system for Singapore's Changi Airport.
The order, received through trading house Mitsubishi Corp, is a contract to design, manufacture, supply, deliver, install and commission the system, Mitsubishi Electric said in a statement.

The system consists of a Meteorological Doppler Weather Radar which provides real-time meteorological information and warnings to airport users for operations, weather briefings and flight planning purposes.
The system will start operating in October 1997, it said.

Last month, an international consortium comprising Mitsubishi Electric, Mitsubishi Corp and Malaysia's XYBase Technologies won an order worth more than $19 million for a similar system to be installed at Kuala Lumpur International Airport.
